hook: Hazy mornings ahead; Hyderabad's NE monsoon rain *74%* short
hook_b: Hazy mornings ahead; Hyderabad's NE monsoon rain *74%* short
tldr: Winter chill and morning haze set in; Hyderabad's Oct 1–Nov 6 rain is 74% below normal.

beats.what: IMD forecasts hazy mornings and partly cloudy skies for the next four days.
beats.why: Recent cyclone rains are over; the city is turning to winter.
beats.care: Morning drives may be slower in haze; dry weeks add pressure on groundwater.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: No IMD alert for the next 7 days. Rain Oct 1–Nov 6 (TGDPS): Telangana 28.7 mm vs 96.4 mm normal (70% short); Hyderabad 30.1 mm vs 117.9 mm (74% short). Peddapalli, Rajanna Sircilla, Kamareddy: 97% short. Temperatures: not given in the report.

cards.q: Hazy winter mornings: what changes for you?

viz.verdict: City got about a quarter of normal rain

insight: IMD forecasts morning haze for four days and no weather alert for a week.

learn.t: NE monsoon = the Oct–Dec rain season, after the main SW monsoon.

watch: IMD's next weekly outlook and any cold-wave note.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: After rain, Hyderabad to see winter chill; IMD forecasts haze

fact: Hyderabad got *30.1 mm* of rain since October 1, against a normal 117.9 mm
twist: Nizamabad district got no rain at all in the same five weeks.
